O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Gurilândia e Land Scholl são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.


Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você irá auxiliar nas atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva nas dependências da escola, garantindo a conservação, segurança e bom funcionamento da infraestrutura física da instituição.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Executar pequenos reparos em estruturas, instalações elétricas, hidráulicas e sanitárias;
  • Realizar serviços de pintura, alvenaria e manutenção de mobiliários;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar serviços de empresas terceirizadas (segurança, limpeza técnica, dedetização, etc.);
  • Realizar vistorias periódicas nas instalações para identificar e prevenir possíveis problemas;
  • Apoiar na montagem e desmontagem de equipamentos e mobiliário em eventos escolares;
  • Cuidar da limpeza e organização de áreas técnicas (salas de manutenção, almoxarifado, etc.);
  • Zelar pela segurança dos alunos e colaboradores durante atividades de manutenção;
  • Seguir normas de segurança do trabalho e utilizar os EPIs adequados.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em elétrica, hidráulica, pintura e alvenaria;
  • Noções de segurança do trabalho;

  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente escolar.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Overview

Mais do que simples fornecedores de tecnologia, nos destacamos como verdadeiros especialistas em logística. Nossas soluções são moldadas pela vasta experiência que acumulamos ao longo dos anos, refletindo a sabedoria e os aprendizados adquiridos ao longo de nossa jornada. É essa expertise que nos capacita a oferecer uma abordagem personalizada e altamente eficaz para cada cliente.

Por mais de 25 anos, trabalhamos com operações logísticas de grande escala, servindo a uma variedade de setores, incluindo indústrias, varejistas, operadores logísticos e transportadoras. Mantendo um olhar perspicaz sobre as tendências do mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas adaptáveis que se ajustam às necessidades em constante evolução de nossos clientes.

Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo ao longo dos últimos anos nos proporcionou um amplo know-how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado.

Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001, garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como ANALISTA DE IMPLANTAÇÃO PLENO . Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar diagnóstico das operações e processos da transportadora para orientar a melhor configuração do sistema.
  • Implantar sistemas de gestão (TMS, ERP, emissor de CT-e, MDF-e, controle de frota, entre outros).
  • Capacitar usuários finais e equipes internas do cliente, conduzindo treinamentos presenciais e/ou remotos.
  • Fazer acompanhamento pós-implantação, prestando suporte na adaptação ao sistema.
  • Identificar necessidades de personalização e repassar demandas à equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir que o sistema esteja em conformidade com as obrigações legais e fiscais do setor (SEFAZ, ANTT, etc).
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e relatórios de implantação

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Conhecimento em rotinas de transportadoras (emissão de CT-e, MDF-e, CIOT, gestão de fretes, controle de veículos e motoristas).
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão (TMS, ERP, WMS ou similares).
  • Facilidade com tecnologia e sistemas web.
  • Boa comunicação e didática para treinamentos.
  • Habilidade para lidar com clientes e diferentes perfis de usuários.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens regulares.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência prévia no setor de transporte e logística.
  • Conhecimento em legislação fiscal aplicada ao transporte rodoviário de cargas.
  • Noções de banco de dados (SQL) e integrações via API.

Additional information

O que esperamos de você:

No KMM by nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia.

Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos pilares culturais e seus atributos são:

  • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética;
  • Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo;
  • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados.

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina.

Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade.

Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação. Além disso:

Behind the scenes of every successful company, there's a team of dedicated individuals committed to ensuring customers receive the support they need. A day in the life of a customer support representative is a rollercoaster of emotions, challenges, and victories. It’s not just about troubleshooting; it’s about creating positive experiences for every customer, fostering trust, and leaving a lasting impression. We are all individuals that have their own set of skills and strengths. When the whole team works as a unit, everyone has an opportunity to learn from each other. As a Customer Support Agent, you are responsible for the effective processing and logistics flow of our total order flow process in the French region and customer satisfaction within the EMEA Fluke Order Management Team.

  • Can-do mentality and strong customer focus.
  • A keen eye for details.

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

Fluke is leading the world in creating software, test tools and technology that will support customers today and in the future. Quais são os requisitos?

  • Ensino Fundamental Completo;

Dentre as suas principais responsabilidades, você irá encontrar:

  • Preparar os materiais e insumos para realização de suas atividades;
  • Separação e identificação de materiais conforme pedido do cliente, bem como sua movimentação;
  • Realizar o armazenamento correto de cada produto;
  • Manejo de equipamentos de acordo com sua estação de trabalho;
  • Realizar conferências, com objetivo de inventário, garantindo qualidade e registro adequado do produto;

  • PPR - Plano de Participação dos Resultados Anual;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Gympass (Rede credenciada de diversas academias);
  • Clube de desconto (Descontos promocionais em diversas categorias).

Sobre a DHL

Conectando pessoas, melhorando vidas.

Torne-se um DHL e obtenha o essencial do seu dia a dia, através dos melhores benefícios, buscamos a sua segurança, a sua saúde e a de sua família.

Construa sua carreira conosco e tenha a oportunidade de crescer por meio de experiências multiculturais que o desafiarão diariamente.

Este não será apenas mais um trabalho, será a sua oportunidade de impactar de maneira positiva o meio ambiente e as pessoas que estão dentro e fora da DHL.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Como empresa global, valorizamos a diversidade de nossos colaboradores como uma verdadeira força, e essa força só poderá ser utilizada se fizermos com que todos sintam que realmente podem ser nós mesmos no dia a dia, independentemente de nossa etnia, religião, orientação sexual, gênero, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica pessoal.

É isso que queremos dizer quando falamos de inclusão. Diversidade é a nossa força. Ser DHL é desenvolver suas capacidades ao máximo.

Responsabilidades da Posição

Vaga: Team Leader (Coordenador) de Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Presencial – Lauro de Freitas – BA

Você tem paixão por liderar times de vendas, energia para formar talentos e visão estratégica para transformar oportunidades em resultados? Quer trabalhar em um ambiente que acredita que a educação pode mudar vidas e impactar milhares de pessoas? Então, essa vaga é para você!

Estamos em busca de um Team Leader de SDRs , responsável por coordenar e impulsionar o time de prospecção e inside sales de duas empresas inovadoras. Além de inspirar pessoas, você terá um olhar voltado a dados — usando métricas e inteligência comercial para tomar decisões, otimizar processos e potencializar a performance do time.

O Que Você Vai Fazer No Dia a Dia

  • Liderar, acompanhar e desenvolver o time de SDRs/Inside Sales.
  • Monitorar e analisar métricas de prospecção e qualificação de leads.
  • Incorporar inteligência de dados na rotina da equipe e nos processos de decisão.
  • Apoiar nas estratégias comerciais e na evolução do funil de vendas.
  • Atuar lado a lado com o time em contatos estratégicos com decisores (diretores, RHs, gestores).
  • Contribuir com insights de mercado e melhorias contínuas.

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência prévia como SDR/Inside Sales e trajetória em liderança ou coordenação de times comerciais.
  • Boa comunicação, escuta ativa e capacidade de engajar pessoas.
  • Organização e disciplina para gerir pipeline e resultados coletivos.
  • Perfil consultivo, curioso e orientado a metas.
  • Interesse e afinidade em usar dados para apoiar decisões e estratégias.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e, por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções, nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico, no qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente.

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

description:
Overview

Sylvera provides trusted ratings, tools and data for carbon credits and CDR. Our mission is to incentivize investment in real climate action.

Sylvera helps organizations ensure they’re making the most effective investments in carbon markets by providing independent and accurate validation of the impact of carbon projects that capture, remove, or avoid emissions. Founded in 2020, Sylvera has 130+ employees globally with offices in London, New York, Belgrade and Singapore. Our team is made up of leading minds in climate change from scientists to policy, finance, and carbon market experts. This position will be remote within the country stated in the header.

Stay curious: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

Na Imex acreditamos que a inovação é a chave para um futuro mais saudável. Somos uma empresa inovadora, com uma forte presença no mercado de saúde e tecnologia. Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos especialistas nesse segmento e a nossa missão é transformar o setor de saúde por meio de equipamentos médicos de alta qualidade, tanto para uso humano quanto veterinário, atuando em todo o Brasil.

Aqui valorizamos o compromisso com resultados e a colaboração entre as pessoas. Valorizamos o comprometimento, a diversidade e a autenticidade de cada um, e acreditamos que quando todos crescem juntos, o impacto é ainda maior.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para fazer a sua história acontecer aqui, precisamos que você domine esses assuntos:

  • Formação técnica ou superior em áreas como Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Física Médica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em processos de manutenção e calibração de equipamentos médicos;
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos com agilidade e precisão;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar;
  • CNH de categoria B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e deslocamentos conforme demanda.

Agora, se você quiser se diferenciar, é bom você ter…

  • Conhecimento em normas regulatórias da ANVISA e demais regulamentações do setor de saúde;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e normas internacionais;
  • Experiência prévia em empresas do segmento de equipamentos médicos ou saúde.

Informações adicionais

O que você ganha ao fazer parte da nossa história

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente inovador e com grande potencial de crescimento profissional;
  • Possibilidade de atuação remota ou em diversos pontos do Brasil, com flexibilidade de horários;

  • Excelente oportunidade de desenvolvimento de carreira no setor de saúde e tecnologia.

Região de atuação?

Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Gurilândia e Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde sua fundação. A Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares: Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Com 60 anos de história em Salvador, estamos educando gerações e preparando nossos alunos para os desafios atuais com uma educação que une vanguarda e tradição.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Contamos com uma equipe de profissionais dedicados, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diários com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel, você auxiliará nas atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva nas dependências da escola, garantindo a conservação, segurança e bom funcionamento da infraestrutura física da instituição.

O que você fará:

  • Executar pequenos reparos em estruturas, instalações elétricas, hidráulicas e sanitárias;
  • Realizar serviços de pintura, alvenaria e manutenção de mobiliários;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar serviços de empresas terceirizadas (segurança, limpeza técnica, dedetização, etc.);
  • Realizar vistorias periódicas nas instalações para identificar e prevenir possíveis problemas;
  • Apoiar na montagem e desmontagem de equipamentos e mobiliário em eventos escolares;
  • Cuidar da limpeza e organização de áreas técnicas (salas de manutenção, almoxarifado, etc.);
  • Zelar pela segurança dos alunos e colaboradores durante atividades de manutenção;
  • Seguir normas de segurança do trabalho e utilizar os EPIs adequados.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. REQUISITOS

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em elétrica, hidráulica, pintura e alvenaria;
  • Noções de segurança do trabalho;
  • Proatividade, responsabilidade e organização;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente escolar.

  • Cursos de NR 10 (Segurança em Instalações Elétricas);
  • Cursos profissionalizantes na área de manutenção predial, elétrica, hidráulica, pintura, ou áreas correlatas.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens. O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

O que você precisa ter:

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. At Wati, we believe that every conversation matters, whether it's engaging a first-time prospect, nurturing a qualified lead, or deepening relationships with loyal clients. We transform these conversations into opportunities for building relationships, and strong relationships lead to increased revenue.

Our Platform

The AI-native platform simplifies complex business operations by bringing all customer interactions under one intelligent roof. We're a fast-growing global team of passionate professionals, and we're now looking for a Sales Development Representative based in Brazil, Mexico or in another country in Latin America to support our expansion in the region.   • Background as a SDR/AE in SaaS with a focus on conversational marketing is a bonus.
  • Consultative sales mindset, resilience in handling objections, and curiosity to constantly learn and adapt.

title: Técnico em Elétrica – Fábrica de Montagem Final
description:
Técnico em Elétrica – Fábrica de Montagem Final

Vaga para o time da Fábrica de Montagem Final.

Buscamos pessoas que assim como a gente, sejam inovadoras, práticas, objetivas, tenham paixão pelo que fazem e visem a excelência. Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?

  • Executar manutenções elétricas em painéis, motores, sensores e sistemas de automação nas linhas da montagem final;
  • Realizar inspeções técnicas para identificar falhas, registrar intervenções em sistema informatizado e apoiar na análise de causas de falhas recorrentes;
  • Participar de projetos de melhorias e comissionamento de novos equipamentos;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas de segurança elétrica (NR-10, NR-12) e contribuir para o alcance dos indicadores de disponibilidade e eficiência das linhas.
  • Curso técnico completo em Elétrica, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Registro no CREA ou CFT;
  • Experiência com manutenção de sistemas industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencial em Camaçari/BA.

Aqui na BYD priorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e estamos em busca constante de melhorias para o nosso pacote de benefícios. Seu pacote vai contar com:

Convênio médico e odontológico coparticipativo para você e seus dependentes;

Cartão Golden Farma para compras em farmácias cadastradas com desconto diretamente em folha, valendo tanto para medicamentos como para itens de higiene e beleza;

Well Hub (antigo Gympass) para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;

Alimentação em refeitório e Vale Alimentação para te ajudar nas compras do mês;

Seguro de vida coletivo Porto Seguro, sem desconto em folha;

Auxílio creche para dependentes,conforme regras de elegibilidade

A BYD (Build Your Dreams ) é uma empresa de alta tecnologia que tem a missão de criar inovações tecnológicaspara uma vida melhor. Fundada em 1995, contamos com mais de 30 parques industriais e estamos presentes em mais de 70 países, provendo excelência nas indústrias de eletrônicos, automóveis, energia limpa e transporte.

A BYD está comprometida com o desenvolvimento sustentável com seus valores de excelência, pragmatismo, paixão e inovação na promoção da geração de energia, armazenamento eficiente e mobilidade elétrica. Estamos presentes no Brasil desde 2015, com unidades em Campinas, São Paulo, Manaus e agora em Camaçari.

Nós nos dedicamos à fabricação de painéis solares, baterias e chassis de ônibus elétricos, e em breve a produção de automóveis híbridos plug-in e elétricos na nossa fábrica em Camaçari, na Bahia. Comercializamos também automóveis, caminhões, furgões, máscaras descartáveis e empilhadeiras elétricas, além de termos um projeto de Skyrail em São Paulo, onde forneceremos trens e sistemas para a Linha 17 – Ouro do Metrô de São Paulo.

Se você, assim como a gente, é prático, objetivo, inovador, apaixonado pelo que faz e focado em excelência, venha se juntar ao nosso time e faça parte da construção de um futuro mais verde! Então, você se encaixa neste perfil?

Alimentar e inspirar as pessoas, transformando sonhos em realidade. Esse é o propósito que nos inspira e faz com que sejamos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil . Reconhecida como líder nacional nos mercados de massas e biscoitos, estamos entre as maiores companhias do mundo nesses segmentos. Com quase sete décadas de existência, marcamos presença em todo o País com marcas regionais, nacionais e, agora, no Uruguai, nossa primeira aquisição internacional. Com um amplo portfólio de produtos que são sinônimos de sabor e qualidade, temos uma relação de confiança e respeito com consumidores de vários perfis.

A partir da nossa sede, localizada na cidade de Eusébio, no Ceará, adotamos uma estratégia bem sucedida de construção e aquisição de novas indústrias. Possuímos um moderno parque industrial, com equipamentos de última geração, seguindo os mais rigorosos padrões de qualidade na produção de alimentos e operando com um modelo de integração vertical, que permite a produção de nossas mais importantes matérias-primas.

Contamos com mais de 17 mil colaboradores distribuídos em 21 unidades industriais no Brasil e 1 no Uruguai . Além disso, temos 29 centros de distribuição, estrategicamente instalados em diferentes Estados, que possibilitam a presença das nossas marcas em todo o território nacional e apoiando à exportação para mais de 40 países. Também negociamos ações no Novo Mercado da B3, bolsa de valores oficial do Brasil.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e ao bem comum, considerando a diversidade como o elemento mais importante para geração de resultados e mudanças significativas. Buscamos construir um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados, independentemente de idade, orientação sexual, gênero ou etnia. Todas as nossas oportunidades são acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência, e valorizamos a autenticidade e o potencial de cada talento.

description:
Overview

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let\'s start the conversation.

At Iron Mountain we protect what our customers value most, from the everyday to the extraordinary. We build customer value around the world with a passion for preserving the physical, transforming the digital, and respecting the environmental. We pioneered the industry for global records and information management and have established some of the best customer relationships in the industry with 95% of the Fortune 1000 companies among our 225,000 loyal customers. Here, you’ll bring your expertise and creativity to a workplace that thrives on continuous improvement. Here, you’ll be part of a global workforce that embraces the differences among us. And here, we’ll encourage you to Climb Higher for the benefit of our customers and each other. There is so much more, but enough about us. We can’t wait to hear about YOU.

Iron Mountain has been an essential and trusted partner to 95% of Fortune 1000 companies and the world’s largest public organizations for more than 70 years. As a world leader in Records and Information Management, we have been proud custodians of our clients’ brand reputation, safeguarding their most important records, information and assets. But we are so much more. We help our clients with Workplace Transformation, Digital Transformation, IT and Data Security and Sustainability. We have a leading portfolio of digital workflow solutions, Asset Life Cycle Management, a network of world-class Data Centers, and more. We uncover insights and new ways of working that help our clients find the gold in their mountain of data…and elevate the power of their work.

Overview

The Global Industries Partner Manager is responsible for developing and executing on the partner “sell with” strategy for assigned Consulting and SI Partners, driving revenue growth, as well as managing and influencing positive business outcomes for our joint customers.

The Partner Manager has shared ownership of sustainable growth with the assigned partners, owning building out and executing a jointly beneficial partnership plan. Role will drive market analysis, understanding the partner’s partner ecosystem, determining the optimal solution and GTM alignment, building commercials and developing enablement and support systems to manage the partner program. Additionally, this position will own lead development, coordinating sales activities including aligning IRM account owners with their corresponding partner sales persons, and overall relationship management.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the Systems Integrator / Consulting landscape and how to traverse those types of organizations, and know how to successfully lead solution identification and valuation with a partner. The candidate should also have a proven track record of success in partner sales and marketing as well as underlying contracting needed to support multinational efforts as identified. The Partner Manager will work closely with all internal solution SMEs and end user assigned sellers to create a seamless experience for both the end user and partner selling organization.

Responsibilities

  • Develops and executes business plan to create incremental pipeline through assigned SI / Consulting partners. Business Plan to include account prioritization and comprehensive partnership engagement model, execution and ongoing maintenance for prioritized accounts.

  • Identifies market validation and longer term strategic opportunities through Account Strategy and jGTM activity.

  • Develop and own exceptional client relationships that cross many verticals, including Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Media and Entertainment, Public Sector, Energy, etc.

  • Build, leverage and communicate Iron Mountain Partnership benefits to key stakeholders within Iron Mountain, focus on the strategic nature of the partner relationship to build long-term value and sustainable success for both Iron Mountain and our Partner.

  • Direct and influence lead generation activities to generate pipeline, align with Sales teams on GTM plays to ensure alignment on goals by providing updated business plan(s) and sharing of best practices across regions.

  • Develops and manages joint Inside/Field Sales processes including deal assignment and registration with the Iron Mountain and partner sales teams, collaborates with Iron Mountain and partner teams to organize joint sales calls.

  • Collaborates with Iron Mountain and Partner Sales Organizations in support of sales campaigns, proposals and closure. Drives team mindshare through regular communication (win stories etc.) and relationship cadence.

  • Enable sales teams (Iron Mountain and Partner) on GTM plays by providing both teams with the relevant knowledge in terms of sales, presales and technical knowledge to effectively grow revenue.

  • Works with IRM field sales to ensure account opportunity visibility into Iron Mountain SFDC tracking pipeline, ensuring appropriate reporting and joint execution plan execution with the partner sales team.

  • Works closely with the Product Marketing, Presales and Product Management teams to develop structured marketing and enablement plans as part of the overall business plans for execution. Manage Iron Mountain / Partner engagement escalations and conflicts

Key Skills, Requirements and Competencies:

  • 5+ year’s successful partner ownership, including business plan development and execution through sales alignment and pipeline development, preferably with large global Systems Integrators, Business Process Outsourcers and / or large global Consulting Organizations.

  • Successful complex solution sales experience in at least one of the following domains (digital transformation, data centers, asset lifecycle management, information management).

  • Exceptional proven sales success working directly with Customer decision makers and key stakeholders

  • Enthusiastic, inclusive, positive, highly energetic.

  • Domain Expertise in one (or more) of the following sectors; Financial Services, Energy, Technology, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Insurance, Manufacturing, etc will be helpful

  • Experience as a strategic account lead for a large and complex global organization, managing relationships with Fortune 100 level customers.

  • Experience working across all levels of a highly matrixed global organization.

  • Strategic mindset and highly consultative approach to partnering with internal and external teams

  • Comfortable in a startup environment

StackHawk helps software developers find and fix security vulnerabilities before they deploy code to production. In the modern world of FinTech, HealthTech, cloud analytics and AI platforms, customers are entrusting their most critical data to software providers. StackHawk leads the market in developer first API security testing and is building a team to scale growth through strategic partnerships with national SIs, VARs, and security services partners.

The Role

StackHawk is looking for a high-caliber partner sales leader to join our growing team. This is a unique opportunity to make a direct impact on StackHawk's high-growth trajectory by driving partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across our most strategic national partner accounts. This highly visible role will be a key contributor to our Americas go-to-market team, responsible for scaling partnerships that bring together sales reach and technical services coverage across the U.S.

As National Partner Director , you will own the national partner strategy and execution, working across sales, marketing, and product to activate and grow partnerships with a select group of Regional and Global System Integrators (SIs), Value-Added Resellers (VARs), and security services partners. You will lead partner activation, joint solution development, business planning, pipeline development, and execution of field programs—all with a focus on driving co-sell and partner-sourced revenue.

What You'll Do

  • Own strategic partnerships with a portfolio of national partners, including relationship management, business planning, and execution.

Experience & Knowledge:

  • 8 to 10 years of experience in partner sales, alliance management, or channel development in cybersecurity.

Education

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

This position requires the candidate to be located in the Pacific Time Zone (PT).

Job Description

The Senior Accounting Manager oversees the general ledger accounting function, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of financial records. This role leads to month-end and year-end close processes, manages a team of accountants, and serves as a key liaison between finance and other departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Close Leadership : Direct the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring deadlines are met and financial statements are accurate
  • GL Reconciliation : Oversee comprehensive reconciliation of general ledger accounts, ensuring accuracy of balances, timely resolution of discrepancies, and proper documentation of reconciliations according to company policies
  • Cash Accounting & Treasury Support : Manage cash accounting activities including bank reconciliations, cash flow reporting, and supporting treasury functions related to cash positioning, investments, debt accounting, and foreign currency transactions
  • Team Management : Lead, develop, and mentor a team of GL accountants; manage workload distribution and performance evaluations
  • Process Improvement : Identify opportunities to streamline accounting processes, implement automation, and enhance internal controls
  • Variance analysis : Oversee the preparation of MoM and YoY variances and reports for internal stakeholders
  • Audit Support : Coordinate with internal and external auditors, ensuring all required documentation is available and accurate
  • Compliance : Ensure adherence to GAAP, SOX requirements, and company policies
  • System Management : Serve as a key resource for GL modules within the ERP system; participate in system implementations and upgrades
  • Intercompany Transactions : Oversee accounting, reconciliation and settlement of intercompany accounts
  • Payroll Accounting : Record and reconcile payroll transactions, prepare related accruals, ensure tax compliance, and manage accounting for employee benefits and equity compensation
  • Fixed Asset & Capitalized Labor Accounting : Oversee fixed asset accounting including acquisitions, transfers, disposals, depreciation, and impairment analyses; manage capitalization of internal labor costs according to accounting standards and company policy
  • M&A Accounting : Support accounting for mergers and acquisitions, including purchase price allocations, goodwill calculations, integration of acquired entities' financial data, and post-acquisition accounting treatments
  • Policy Development : Develop and maintain accounting policies and procedures
  • Special Projects : Lead accounting-related projects and initiatives as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA required
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience with at least 5 years in a management role
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP/IFRS and financial reporting requirements
  • Experience with month-end close processes, account reconciliations, and financial statement preparation
  • Understanding of cash management, banking relationships, and treasury operations
  • Knowledge of fixed asset accounting, capitalization criteria, and depreciation methodologies
  • Understanding of M&A accounting, business combinations, and purchase accounting
  • Understanding of payroll accounting principles and tax compliance requirements
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, etc.) and fixed asset modules
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial reporting tools
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in process improvement and automation initiatives

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and resources that encourage a healthy lifestyle. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $107,089 - $125,000 annually, and will be based on a number of factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Senior Production Operations Director – Overview

As the Senior Production Operations Director, you will oversee the day-to-day operations for a portfolio of clients ranging from Fortune 500 brands to startups, ensuring the efficient delivery of high-quality content at scale. You will manage production workflows, resource allocation, and project timelines to drive seamless execution across digital, transcreation, and 360° campaigns, while also identifying and implementing AI-driven efficiencies to optimize processes.

In this role, you will be responsible for building, improving, and enforcing Ways of Working that enhance operational efficiency, streamline production processes, and ensure scalability. A key part of your mandate will be to evaluate AI opportunities, develop training programs, and integrate automation into workflows to drive both speed and cost efficiency. As a strategic and executional leader, you will collaborate closely with account management, creative, design, editorial, animation, and copywriting teams to implement AI-enhanced solutions while maintaining alignment with client expectations and business objectives.

This Senior Director-level role requires a balance of strategic vision, hands-on execution, and innovation, ensuring scalability as new clients are onboarded and continuous process improvement to support business growth through AI-driven transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operational Leadership: Oversee the full project lifecycle, from intake and planning to execution, ensuring alignment with business objectives and client needs.
  • Production Workflow Management: Develop and refine Ways of Working to drive efficiency, transparency, and scalability across teams and projects.
  • Resource & Capacity Planning: Forecast production volumes to optimize staffing levels and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget while maintaining high-quality outputs.
  • Team & Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams—including Account Management, Creative, and Capability teams—to deliver results in a cost-efficient and strategic manner.
  • Process Documentation & Optimization: Maintain detailed documentation of workflows and lead continuous improvements based on lessons learned and industry best practices.
  • Financial & Budget Oversight: Manage budgets and financial forecasts in collaboration with key stakeholders, ensuring resource allocation aligns with production demands.
  • AI Integration & Innovation: Identify opportunities for AI-driven efficiencies, develop a training and implementation roadmap, and lead the rollout across production teams.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Provide guidance to a core team of three direct reports, while influencing and supporting a dynamic team that scales between 10 and 30 members.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify challenges, mitigate risks, and implement solutions to keep production workflows efficient and client satisfaction high.

About You

  • Proven leadership experience at the intersection of Production and Operations within a high-volume studio, agency, or creative production environment.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end production workflows, resource management, and financial oversight, with the ability to balance operational efficiency with creative excellence.
  • Experience overseeing large-scale, multi-format content production, including digital, print, transcreation, and campaign adaptation.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and client satisfaction.
  • Strategic thinker with a solutions-oriented mindset, skilled at navigating complexity and driving continuous improvement.
  • Experience in resource forecasting, budget planning, and cost management to ensure financial and operational health.
  • Familiarity with AI applications in production workflows and the ability to identify, implement, and scale AI efficiencies across teams.
  • A collaborative leader who thrives in cross-functional environments, working with account, creative, and operations teams to deliver outstanding results.

Success In This Role Is Measured By

  • Production speed: Delivering high-quality content efficiently and on schedule.
  • Operational efficiency: Optimizing processes, resource utilization, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Client satisfaction: Ensuring the right talent and resources are in place, maintaining budgets, and delivering on time to meet client expectations seamlessly.
  • Scalability & AI adoption: Expanding AI-driven efficiencies and improving workflows across teams.

About Monks

Monks is the global, purely digital, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global marketing and technology services to accelerate business possibilities and redefine how brands and businesses interact with the world. Its integration of systems and workflows delivers unfettered content production, scaled experiences, enterprise-grade technology and data science fueled by AI—managed by the industry\'s best and most diverse digital talent—to help the world\'s trailblazing companies outmaneuver and outpace their competition.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave: Global Marketing Services. It has remained a constant presence on Adweek\'s Fastest Growing lists, ranks among Cannes Lions\' Top 10 Creative Companies and is the only partner to have been placed in AdExchanger\'s Programmatic Power Players list every year. In addition to being named Adweek\'s first AI Agency of the Year (2023), Monks has been recognized by Business Intelligence in its 2024 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Awards program in three categories: the Individual category, Organizational Winner in AI Strategic Planning and AI Product for its service Monks.Flow. Monks has also garnered the title of Webby Production Company of the Year, won a record number of FWAs and has earned a spot on Newsweek\'s Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces 2023.

Join to apply for the .NET Test Automation Engineer role at EPAM Systems .

This 100% online program is designed to equip you with practical, hands-on experience in test automation using the (dot)NET framework. It is ideal for beginners with some programming experience. Participation is limited and selection is based on your technical assessment results and timing of your application.

What You’ll Learn

  • Practical knowledge of C# programming and object-oriented design concepts
  • Core principles of software testing, including manual and automated testing methodologies
  • An introduction to testing frameworks and tools used in the (dot)NET ecosystem
  • Fundamentals of writing and executing automated tests for various types of applications
  • Best practices for maintaining test code and interpreting test results
  • Experience with test case creation, test planning, and defect tracking

By the end of the program, you’ll be ready to advance to more specialized courses and begin exploring real-world opportunities in QA automation — whether within EPAM or across the wider tech industry.

Requirements

  • English level from B2 or higher
  • Self-learning and self-discipline skills
  • Willingness to embrace new knowledge and process information
  • Basic understanding of information technology concepts and software operation
  • Aspiring to enter the IT industry without prior experience, technical education, or an IT-related background

What we offer

  • Flexible Learning: study at your own pace and choose a convenient time that fits your schedule
  • No engineering experience required: ideal for students without prior IT experience
  • Accessible anywhere in Colombia: enrol in the course and study from any location within Colombia
  • Global expertise: course is developed by EPAM experts from different countries
  • High-quality content: relevant to the current state of the IT industry
  • Practical knowledge for future careers: course combines practical and useful knowledge to enhance your skills
  • Opportunity to receive a constandia after graduation (note: exact wording should be verified with HR)

We offer

  • Connectivity Bonus (15,000 ARS paid with a salary receipt at the end of each month)
  • Medicina Prepaga (covers the collaborator and direct family)
  • Paternity Leave (total of 4 days)
  • Discounts card
  • Training Program (access to multiple customized training plans)
  • Referral Program (bonus when a referred collaborator joins)
  • External Agreements and Discounts
  • Vacations: 14 calendar days a year

By applying to our role, you are agreeing that your personal data may be used as set out in EPAM’s Privacy Notice and Policy.

EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture with opportunities to collaborate with multi-national teams and contribute to innovative projects.

title: Data Scientist II / Senior Data Scientist
description:
Join to apply for the Data Scientist II / Senior Data Scientist role at Microsoft

We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home! As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and has created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

Main qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset with resilience and a passion for learning.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

description:
Overview

Who We Are TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. We are an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers. We design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location

This role will operate remotely (US or Canada) OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Vancouver, BC, or Toronto, ON.

The Opportunity

As the Client Account Director for a leading digital health client of TELUS Digital, you will co-deliver bold digital health strategies with executive stakeholders and turn them into market-ready products, positioning TELUS Digital as the go-to partner across the health ecosystem. You’ll deepen executive partnerships, deploy world-class teams on high-stakes initiatives, and translate innovative ideas into revenue through rapid pilots with Practice Leaders. You\'ll work with vertical leads and practice leaders to mine work delivered into external market offerings. If you thrive at the nexus of strategy, productization, and large-scale delivery, join us to shape the future of digital health.

Responsibilities

Building our Company

  • Drives teams to provide fresh perspectives, breakthrough ideas, and new paradigms that can be leveraged to grow accounts
  • Initiates, influences, and drives organizational changes and business transformation.

Focusing on Customers

  • Accountable for proposal development and articulating staffing needs across accounts serviced
  • Responsible for procurement relationships to create efficiencies and streamline existing processes to lower overhead.

  • Track revenue, oversee delivery in partnership with delivery leads, and identify win/win commercial constructs

Leading our Market

  • Serve as an advisor to key client stakeholders and industry leaders

Developing our People

  • Provide people management to consultants and/or client managers, and career coaching/guidance
  • Provides real-time feedback, coaches, and mentors staff at all levels of the organization in a manner that drives them to excel
  • Builds high-performing teams by integrating a diversity of skills and personalities and creating a shared purpose.

Competencies

  • 5+ years shaping strategy and leading high‑performing teams in a top‑tier management consultancy, owning a client relationship
  • End‑to‑end digital‑transformation expertise —from technology advisory and complex program delivery to productization and go‑to‑market execution—earned on multi‑year engagements with Fortune‑500 clients or leading health‑tech innovators.
  • Deep knowledge of enterprise healthcare software engineering. Comfortable discussing modern architectures, cloud‑native services, and scalability patterns with technical leaders.
  • Board‑room presence and C‑suite trust. A track record of advising executives, navigating enterprise governance, and translating vision into measurable KPIs and investment cases.
  • Proven operator. Hands‑on experience deploying agile and scaled‑agile methods, managing global talent pools, and hitting margin targets in fast‑moving environments.
  • Customer‑experience authority. Deep fluency in service‑design thinking, omnichannel journeys, and data‑driven personalization techniques that boost NPS and lifetime value.
  • Change‑and risk‑management savvy. Comfortable steering large‑scale organizational change while safeguarding quality, compliance, and patient privacy.
  • Clear, influential communicator able to simplify complexity, rally cross‑functional teams, and inspire confidence at every level.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent graduate degree strongly preferred.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Elixir
description:
Overview

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Join our dynamic team as a talented and fast-paced engineer and play a pivotal role in our product expansion. At Stord, engineers are empowered to own entire features, influencing specifications, building and enhancing our Elixir/Phoenix back-end, and collaborating with the React front-end. You’ll be instrumental in the ongoing improvement of a product that is revolutionizing the third-party logistics (3PL) industry. Leading omni-channel brands rely on our innovative, world-class logistics network software to optimize their warehouse processes and order fulfillment, leveraging its powerful automations and order management tools to achieve cost savings and operational excellence.

What Youll Do

  • Drive the evolution of the Stord platform by owning the complete lifecycle of new features: from conception and testing to iterative delivery.
  • Contribute to and enhance both our robust back-end (Elixir/Phoenix) and engaging front-end (React) services.
  • Partner with teams across the organization to gain deep insights into customer and vendor needs, develop effective solutions, and rapidly bring them to life through prototyping, iteration, and launch.
  • Collaborate with a team of bright and driven individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional work.
  • Engage with and solve a wide spectrum of challenging technical and groundbreaking supply chain problems.

What Youll Need

  • A genuine passion for building exceptional software that provides outstanding user experiences.
  • Highly effective communication skills to articulate ideas and collaborate effectively.
  • A strong belief in the value of test-driven development and collaborative code reviews.
  • The ability to adapt quickly and thrive in the dynamic environment of a startup.
  • A minimum of 5 years of professional experience with Elixir or other functional programming paradigms.
  • Solid experience with Model-View-Controller (MVC) frameworks.
  • Experience in transforming design wireframes into fully functional production features.
  • The ability to produce clean, dependable, and easily maintainable code.
  • A strong intrinsic motivation to tackle and resolve complex issues.

Bonus Points

  • Previous startup experience
  • Previous logistics or supply chain experience

This role is ONLY open to candidates residing in LATAM or Europe (EU).

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.

10+ years’ experience deploying large, sophisticated Cloud SaaS ERP (HCM & Fins) solutions at a project and program manager level within the any of the following: Healthcare, Diversified Industries, State, Local, Federal Government, FSI, Higher Education arenas

title: Head of Sales (Life & Supplemental Health)
description:
Overview

We\'re seeking a Head of Sales to lead the health and growth of our most critical business lines. This dynamic, high-visibility role involves managing a team of talented, motivated sales professionals and overseeing the full sales process with prospective enterprise-level clients. Candidates must have experience with multi-stakeholder relationships and a consultative sales approach. Our clients value our multi-carrier service solutions, and this leader must be strategic, solutions-oriented, and quick-thinking in serving as the primary liaison with broker, carrier, and client partners.

The ideal candidate will bring an established network, a strong track record of lead generation, success in executive-level consultative selling, and a history of closing complex deals. They should be an effective collaborator and relationship manager, both internally and externally. This role is accountable for strategic account growth and revenue objectives and will support sales team expansion, process development, recruiting, and leadership collaboration.

The Head of Sales also provides leadership for the sales team, including training, performance management, work allocation, and implementation of best practices. This role will act as a strategic thought partner to client executives, shape key materials such as pitch decks and case studies and help guide clients through contracting and onboarding. Additionally, the Head of Sales will collaborate with Marketing and Client Management to identify market needs and implement scalable client solutions.

Your Impact

  • Design team organizational structure to effectively meet Department responsibilities and goals.
  • Identify appropriate staffing levels and skills to fulfill objectives and tasks within budget parameters.
  • Assist in the development of Key Performance Metrics for areas of responsibility and regularly report KPI results.
  • Establish annual team and team member performance goals. Regularly report progress against established goals. Adjust goals and communicate new goals as circumstances require.
  • Supervise, coach and mentor team. Establish performance objectives and goals. Provide regular feedback to team members as well as quarterly, formal reviews. Update senior leadership regularly on performance of team. Establish tangible employee development plans and regularly update senior leadership on progress.
  • Manage requests for services and capabilities from prospective clients and broker/distribution partners of clients, collaborate with Operations and I.T. for reasonable solutions and regularly communicate progress to client and company leadership.
  • Maintain SME status on markets under management. Monitor changes and continuously update Client Management, Sales and Product & Supplier leadership.
  • Oversee the planning and preparation of prospective client presentations and meetings. Serve as lead in prospective client presentations and meetings.
  • Collaborate with Human Resources to select team members with identified skills that align clearly with defined roles and responsibilities.
  • Monitor Operations to identify opportunities to expand service offerings and/or improve processes via identification of best practices. Collaborate with Operations owner and Project Manager to implement identified process improvements.

Successful Candidates Will Have

  • Minimum 8 years of business development, consulting or sales experience in the insurance industry
  • Active Life & Health and Property & Casualty license required
  • Bachelor\'s degree preferred
  • Life and/or health insurance company, administrator or brokerage experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management and development experience. Talent development and alignment of employee personal/professional goals to corporate objectives.
  • Effective in balancing costs and resources vs. scope and requirements for client development and new business opportunities
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
  • Decision-making, problem resolution and creative thinking skills
  • Must demonstrate daily cross-functional team support at peer, subordinate & senior management levels

About One80 Intermediaries

One80 Intermediaries is a privately held firm with offices throughout the US and Canada. As a leading insurance wholesaler and program manager, One80 offers placement services and binding authority for property and casualty, life, travel/accident and health, affinity and administrative services, and warranty business. Launched just four years ago, One80 Intermediaries has grown to be one of the largest intermediaries in the United States. In 2024, One80 Intermediaries was ranked the 14th largest broker in the U.S. by Business Insurance. In 2025, One80 Intermediaries earned the Great Place To Work Certification for the second consecutive year.

Compensation & Benefits

At One80 Intermediaries, base pay is one part of our total compensation package, which also includes a comprehensive suite of benefits, including, for eligible employees, medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings. Also, for eligible employees, the Company offers 10 to 20 vacation days depending on experience and generally offers 11 paid holidays and 5 half days, depending on the calendar year. The total compensation for a position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. The expected base pay range for this position is between $147,700 - $165,000 plus commission. The actual base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including geographical location, education, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

description:
Role Purpose

The Head of Sales - Americas is responsible for leading and scaling Jumio's global new business sales organization, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives across all key verticals, including Gaming, Financial Services, Sharing Economy, Travel, and more. This role will oversee the execution of Jumio's go-to-market strategy, drive enterprise customer acquisition, and lead a high-performing team of sales professionals to exceed revenue goals. This is a high-impact leadership role focused on driving growth, optimizing performance, and making identity verification safer and more accessible around the world.

Role Value

The Head of Sales plays a critical role in driving sustainable revenue growth and market share expansion in the evolving identity verification and compliance technology space. By providing strategic direction, enabling cross-functional collaboration, and fostering a high-performance sales culture, this leader directly contributes to Jumio's global success and long-term value. A strong sales engine, led by this role, will amplify Jumio's market leadership and continue to deliver meaningful innovation to our customers.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a world-class new business sales team across key regions and verticals
  • Define and execute Jumio's enterprise sales strategy to meet and exceed revenue and growth targets
  • Drive accountability and performance through data-driven coaching, KPIs, and forecasting discipline
  • Own pipeline development and revenue forecasting processes, ensuring accuracy and transparency across the organization
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Executive Leadership to deliver integrated, customer-first go-to-market execution
  • Establish scalable processes and best practices for enterprise sales execution, including deal reviews, enablement, and competitive positioning
  • Cultivate executive-level customer and partner relationships to support strategic pursuits and long-term expansion
  • Represent Jumio at industry events, partner summits, and customer engagements to elevate the company's presence and brand
  • Hire, onboard, and retain top talent while building a high-performance, diverse, and inclusive sales culture
  • Drive continuous improvement in pipeline quality, sales efficiency, and conversion rates

Experience and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales leadership experience, with a track record of building and managing high-performing teams across geographies
  • 5+ years leading quota-carrying teams selling complex software or SaaS solutions with deal sizes ranging from $500K to $10M+
  • Demonstrated success scaling revenue and building repeatable enterprise sales processes in a high-growth B2B environment
  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales methodologies and CRM systems (Salesforce experience preferred)
  • Ability to develop and execute GTM plans aligned with company goals and market dynamics
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Experience working in a matrixed, collaborative environment and partnering cross-functionally across product, marketing, finance, and customer success

Great to Have Experience and Qualifications

  • Background in the identity verification, fraud prevention, compliance, or cybersecurity industries
  • Experience selling into regulated industries such as Gaming, Fintech, or Financial Services
  • Knowledge of IDV, AML, and KYC markets and competitors
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and international markets

Compensation

The hiring range for this position is from $185,000 to $250,000 base. This is based on Jumio's US national salary band for the role. Geographical adjustment is applied for tier 1 locations and more may be available based on your experience and skills. This position also qualifies for a variable compensation package, including performance-based incentives. Excellent benefits including medical and dental insurance, health and wellness programs, peer recognition, flexible time off, and 401K match are provided for all US employees.

Jumio Values

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

Equal Opportunities

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

About Jumio

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we\'re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.
